authorization_context: User explicitly requested resumed execution after being informed that reboot interrupted the prior run and the original oracle deadline expired. Parent will issue a separately hashed adoption and verify startup once.

scope.excluded: Scoring, learner-continuation diagnostics, training, held-out evaluation, outcome interpretation, and unseen evaluation require separate adoption. Existing sources, environments, datasets, models, and original output directories remain immutable.

evidence.review_access: Local technical metadata, contracts, and source only; no remote calls, simulator calls, or partial scientific outcome inspection.

adoption_interface.new_window_started_unix: Parent freezes one absolute Unix timestamp immediately before deployment; this value must be hash-bound in the adoption.
adoption_interface.replay_deadline_unix: At replay stage start, min(stage_start_unix + 7200, original_global_deadline_unix - 30); persist in immutable stage request before launch.

rules: The new oracle window includes deployment, verification, hashing, prefix copying, launch overhead, processing, and final stage verification. Never renew it at controller or worker start.
Recheck absolute deadlines after preflight and final output hashing. No worker may start after its remaining window is exhausted.
Use monotonic countdowns derived from the adopted absolute deadlines for runtime watchdogs. Preserve existing owned-process cleanup reserves.
Global elapsed wall includes all interruption, reboot, offline preparation, and waiting since the original study start. It is never refunded.
A fresh failure, incomplete record, deadline exhaustion, or budget exhaustion stops this adoption. No automatic repeat, extended window, replacement subset, or rescue run.
wall_budget_revision.justification: A single finite 12-hour CPU oracle window is an operational recovery allowance selected before outcome access, matching the original oracle stage's nominal maximum duration. It is explicitly additional stage opportunity after expiry, not a claim that the original stage wall budget remains satisfied. It cannot guarantee completion of the remaining 43 pools.

historical_wall_reporting.interpretation: Last durable ledger elapsed excludes the final pending call through process disappearance. Stage-start-to-reboot is a conservative occupancy upper bound, not measured CPU time or proof of survival until reboot. Report these separately; never present their sum as exact compute.

lineage_invariants: Resume1 totals equal original oracle totals plus resume1 stage_counts, counter by counter. Collection totals plus combined prior oracle counts equal resume1 totals.
Resume2 starts from resume1 totals exactly once. Do not add original totals again or copy costs twice when copying 137 rows.
Remaining oracle stage allowance equals original oracle limit minus original stage_counts minus resume1 stage_counts. Retain unchanged global limits and debit all future calls normally.
Both historical uncertain step returns remain uncertain, fully charged as started calls. Clear no historical gap and invent no completion; retain each historical active-call provenance.

For a clean new stage, new started/completed counts balance, new active_call is null, and cumulative gap remains exactly two. Any fresh uncertain call stops technical completion and is disclosed separately.
Replay inherits final oracle totals and uses the unchanged original replay count and time caps. Copying old records is not a new simulator interaction; replaying an incomplete anchor is.

prefix_continuity: Hash-lock all source generations and technical inventories before launch. Validate original131 is the exact byte prefix of resumed137 for records and corresponding committed events.

Stream the 137 complete resumed records in original collection-anchor order, validating every pool and associated committed event against the frozen contract. Preserve raw bytes, not merely JSON equality.
137 is a fixed complete contiguous prefix, not a subset selected by oracle result. No complete pool is recomputed or replaced.

Preserve all original artifacts and costs. Exclude only validated trailing events for the next incomplete anchor from the new canonical event stream; retain their count, bytes, and hash as historical provenance. Reject unexpected complete rows or out-of-order trailing events.
Reexecute the incomplete next anchor from its original causal history in the real simulator, then all remaining fixed anchors. Do not reuse partially advanced or counterfactual observations.
No scientific pass or failure is inferred from the prefix. Any residual technical missingness prevents complete-acquisition or gate claims.

rules: Require current boot identity and boot time to equal the frozen technical inventory before launch and worker execution. Another reboot invalidates this adoption.
Verify old stage/controller timestamps precede current boot and bind their original identities in historical provenance. An old process cannot survive reboot.
Never infer old ownership from a numeric PID or session ID after reboot, even if start ticks collide. Ignore such unrelated collisions when proving historical process exit; never signal them.

For every new owned process bind boot ID, PID, start ticks, and owned session; acquire pidfd before using it for cleanup. Preserve exact same-boot identity checks, signal-masked spawn, timeout, and descendant cleanup.
Do not apply pre-reboot numeric session membership rejection to post-reboot sessions. A genuinely same-boot matching live owner must still prevent duplicate execution.

remaining_acceptance_requirements: Independent exact-source implementation review and pure-fixture validation of cumulative accounting, absolute deadlines, prefix preservation, and cross-boot identity collisions.
Parent creates a unique exact-hash v2 adoption and new output paths, explicitly disclosing the oracle wall extension.
Verify actual controller/worker startup once and stop external monitoring. Internal finite deadline enforcement and owned-child cleanup remain required.
Later scientific review requires complete artifacts and resume-aware lineage validation; this design review alone establishes neither execution success nor scientific improvement.
